safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tried E45 cream and antihistamines with minimal relief.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting prior use of antihistamines may slightly reduce clarity about what has already been tried for itch control, but it is unlikely to change the diagnosis of contact dermatitis or materially affect safety. The main management (trigger avoidance, emollients, topical steroid) would remain appropriate.
